name: ALComplete
description: ALComplete adds a draggable gameplay control, instant-completion action, and configurable appearance and behavior. Completion may affect local progress and does not guarantee a verified record.

show-floating-button.name: Show Floating Button
show-floating-button.description: Show or hide the draggable in-level control.

button-icon.name: Button Icon
button-icon.description: Cycle choices in the popup: 0 = AL, 1 = asterisk, 2 = OK.

button-color.name: Button Color
button-color.description: Circle color preset: 0 green, 1 pink, 2 gray, 3 blue, 4 cyan, 5 dark purple, 6 dark aqua, 7 red.

confirm-before-complete.name: Confirm Before Completing
confirm-before-complete.description: Ask for confirmation before calling the game's completion routine.

snap-to-edge.name: Snap To Edge
snap-to-edge.description: Snap the floating control to the nearest screen edge after dragging.
